mostWorthwhile.text: Adding mineral to the collagen framework was especially worthwhile: the planned comparison connects collagen's toughness and mineral's compression resistance to bone structure.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding bone cells to the framework was comparatively straightforward, though the channels in the cutaway helped make their location clear.

surprise.text: The bone-cell lineage showed that some matrix-producing osteoblasts become embedded osteocytes with processes through tiny channels.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the supplied descriptions made the structural pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: building the joint linked cartilage, fluid and ligaments to distinct aspects of movement and support, although the planned illustrations alone cannot establish what students would understand.
